title: Research: what wins, what's overdone
note: Four research agents mapped the Gemma on-device stack, robot SDKs, physical prompt-injection prior art, and recent hackathon winners. Winners: one clear task for a named person, done live on real hardware. Overdone: blind narrators, chatbots, benchmark-only projects.
say: We studied what won before and built for a real person: an elderly guest who needs a hand.
